assertion_audit.fails_if: The dispatcher makes zero or multiple composition calls.
The real dispatcher requests a review of another run.
The real dispatcher uses the original head rather than the repaired git commit.
A second landing pass composes another review instead of consuming the stored one.

assertion_independence: Mock returns only dispatched=True; none of the new expectations read that supplied value. Run identity comes from the delivered pointer and repaired head comes from git commit output; the actual request arguments are constructed by the real dispatcher.
evidence_caveats: Test-only change has no production caller; the named runtime paths are exercised by the test, not callers of it.
External worker launch remains stubbed at composition; review storage and pending-landing transitions are real.
Source worker normalized scheduler-notice placement and retained raw .asreceived captures; no suites were rerun for this read-only review.

item_verdicts.diff: Read 81a03146da27aec7acbffdaa77f3f9ea4fdafd18 against previously reviewed d09c2786cb097582470b9c4733bd9c192fa7218b; it replaces the local compose definition with unittest.mock.Mock and preserves the run/head and single-request checks, with the earlier two commits read only as context.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source run's scoped-gate-1794983743708925683.log records 19 passed and after_suite-1794983837596224315.log records 77 passed at 81a03146da27aec7acbffdaa77f3f9ea4fdafd18; the parent arm records 77 passed and the documented historical control exposes awaiting-review.
item_verdicts.goal: Live docs/plans/delivered-work-lands-without-a-coordinator.html section 25 permits the automatically requested review contract, and the incremental Mock replacement at tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py:551 preserves it while answering the prior recorder-duplication finding.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest names the incremental commit, parent revision, passing gate captures and failing clone-control capture, explicitly distinguishing the original base pointer failure from the adjusted awaiting-review control.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source manifest declares tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py and it is the only path changed by the incremental commit 81a03146da27aec7acbffdaa77f3f9ea4fdafd18.

justifications.durability: tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py:556-558 fails if dispatch is omitted, repeated, targets another run or uses the pre-repair head, and :583 fails if the stored review causes a second dispatch; the expectations use observed git and run identities rather than the Mock return value.
justifications.evidence: Source after_suite-1794983837596224315.log identifies the reviewed head and records 77 passed with EXIT=0, its parent arm also records 77 passed, and reuse-negative.log records the reinstated recorder duplication failing while reuse-head.log passes.
justifications.fit: tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py:12 imports standard unittest.mock.Mock and :551-558 uses its ordinary call assertions with descriptive names consistent with surrounding monkeypatch-based tests.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py:551 preserves the allowed review-before-landing behavior and answers the prior duplication finding without changing the existing product contract.
justifications.reuse: tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py:551 replaces the duplicated recorder capability found and opened at tests/test_a_repaired_head_is_reviewed_and_landed.py:131 with standard-library Mock, adds no definition, and continues using the existing production dispatcher and review store.
justifications.scope_discipline: Commit 81a03146da27aec7acbffdaa77f3f9ea4fdafd18 changes only declared tests/test_concurrent_edits_land_unattended.py to remove the duplicated test recorder and retain its assertions.
